lede.text: Plates face the stream that must obey them (painted face = travel + 180°). UK nearside is left of travel. Exceptions: offside/central-island duplicates, rear-facing end plates, cantilevers, side-road facing plates, mapped portal gantries in the running lane.
lede.source: engine-default (TSM Ch.1/3/4 not in this tree)

verge_std.text: UK nearside verge, half-width + 0.8 m (engine-default lateral offset). Face of flow (face normal opposes travel).

gw_stop.text: 602 / 601.1: left of the minor approach, before diagram 1003A / 1002.1 (TSM Chapter 3 not read — distance unsourced). 611.1 at a mini-roundabout: 1.5 m before the give-way line, maximum 12 m (TSM5 §6.3.6).

stack.text: Same post as a co-tagged plate (e.g. 530A over 629.2A). Verge.

both_kerbs.text: Both sides of the entry (616, bus gate when co-tagged).

refuge.text: On the refuge / island centre, not the verge (610 / 611). Underside 0.55 m is an engine-default.

signals.text: Primary head stands beyond (downstream of) the 1001 stop line. Secondary head on the far side of the junction. The cooker currently plants one kerbside head per approach (engine-default).

crossing.text: Both kerbs. Zebra: Belisha (TSRGD 4007). Signal crossing: pedestrian heads.

portal.text: Mapped gantry only. Underside clearance 5.5 m (unsourced — DMRB not checked). Width = way length clamped 8–18 m (engine heuristic).

wigwag.text: Both sides of a mapped level crossing, ~2 m before the running rail.

marker.text: Back of hard shoulder + 1.2 m. Never in the running lane. Not a TSRGD diagram.

footway_dir.text: Underside 2.1 m if a footway/cycleway/path is within 4 m; else 1.5 m verge. Distances are engine-defaults.

street_name.text: Named OSM corner (≥3 arms, ≥2 names). Face the named street. Underside 0.80 m. Not a TSRGD diagram.
